```
['create an AwesomeAlignWrapper instance to align bilingual word pairs using the awesome-align model', 'run embed_words on a list of words to get embeddings and subword to word mapping', 'run align_single_pair on source and target word lists to find mutual alignments above threshold', 'run force_align_single_pair to get sure alignments and extra alignments covering all unaligned words', 'review the reverse_mapping function that maps word indices to lists of subword indices']
```
